core.title: Bakery drops the Friday route
core.setting: The owner of Copper Kettle Café whose assistant schedules barista shifts, supplier deliveries, and catering orders

events.text: Standing rule: any supplier order above 250 in total needs Priya Nair's sign-off before it is placed. Priya is our finance lead.
Standing rule: once a catering booking is confirmed with a client, its date or service window may not be changed without the client's written consent.
Standing rule: shifts in the published roster may not be moved or retimed without the agreement of the barista named on the shift.
Confirming our delivery arrangement with Copper Kettle Café: we deliver on Tuesdays and Fridays, arriving by 7:00 in the morning. Standing price on bread loaves is 2.10 each.
Quote for Copper Kettle Café: milk at 1.05 per litre, delivered on Monday mornings.

I've set up a standing bread order with Hearthside Bakery: 40 loaves on their Friday delivery run, at 2.10 a loaf, so about 84 a week — well under the 250 sign-off threshold, so no need to bother Priya.
Happy to take the Friday 6:30 opening shifts if you need someone early to receive deliveries.
Rostered Jonas Adeyemi for the Friday 6:30 opening shift every week, so he is there to receive the Hearthside bread delivery of 40 loaves.
We'd like a monthly staff brunch at the café for 30 people, starting Saturday 12 September, budget around 420 per brunch. Can you do bread and pastries?

Confirmed the Larkspur Design Studio brunch: monthly on Saturdays at 10:30 for 30 guests, Hearthside Bakery supplying the bread and pastries, 420 per brunch. Booking is confirmed with Wren, so any change to the date needs her written consent.
The new menu cards look great on the counter — reorder the same design next time.
Cinnamon croissants are 1.80 each if you'd like them on your regular Tuesday run.
Added a standing Tuesday order with Hearthside Bakery: 30 croissants at 1.80 each on the Tuesday morning run, 54 a week — no sign-off needed.
Hearthside Bakery invoice for July supplies: 738 in total.
Pay the Hearthside Bakery July invoice of 738 by 15 August.
Just a heads up, I can also cover Sunday afternoons if the roster needs it.
Set up a standing order with Fernbrook Dairy: 60 litres of milk every Monday at 1.05 a litre, 63 a week.
Just confirming the current standing arrangement: 40 loaves delivered every Friday morning by 7:00, plus the Tuesday croissants. All as agreed.
Rostered Tomas Rivera for the Sunday closing shifts from next month, with his agreement as required for roster changes.
Staff meeting notes: winter menu trial in November, patio heaters to be checked before the first frost.

Confirmed a catering booking with Northgate Yoga Studio: Friday 20 November in the evening, 25 guests, tea and pastries, 350. Confirmed with the studio, so the date can't move without their written consent.
Roster reminder: Jonas Adeyemi has the Friday 6:30 opening shift each week to take in the Hearthside bread delivery of 40 loaves.
Thank you — the September brunch was lovely. See you on the second Saturday of October as usual.
We can service espresso machines on weekdays, callout fee 95, morning or afternoon slots available.
Booked Meridian Repairs for the espresso machine service on Tuesday 10 November, morning slot, 95 callout.
Hearthside Bakery invoice for September supplies: 702 in total.
Renew the café music licence before 30 October.

Some news from us: we are dropping our Friday delivery route from the week of 26 October — too few stops on it. Your deliveries will be on Tuesdays and Thursdays instead, still arriving by 7:00. Thursday should work fine for your bread. Same prices, nothing else changes.
Reminder that the quarterly rent for the Copper Kettle Café premises is due on 1 November.
Small scheduling note: from November our Tuesday run will arrive at 6:15 instead of 7:00, as the route got shorter. Thursday arrival times stay at 7:00.
Heads up: milk goes up to 1.10 a litre from January. Everything else stays the same.
All set for my usual early shift this week — see you Friday morning.
Let's trial the winter menu starting next week — pumpkin spice and the chestnut loaf.
Looking forward to the brunch on Saturday the 14th — 30 of us as always. Same bread and pastries would be perfect.
